TC-11/S18.title: Hospital day window on sparse and messy ledgers: only yesterday's and today's lines
TC-11/S18.detail: Dev, build e02167f, dataset course-hosp. Our addition (review TFA-92589), so record only. Four Hospital rows added by the spec with ledgers labelled from the server clock in the browser's zone (Oct 15 = today): HA 'Oct 12' + 'Oct 15'; HB only 'Oct 13'; HC only 'Oct 14'; HD an undated line, 'Oct 10', 'Oct 14', 'Oct 15' and 'Oct 12' typed beneath today's. On the Pre-Round tab: HA shows only 'Oct 15: Breathing easier' (no Oct 12 card, no filler for yesterday); HB shows no card; HC shows only 'Oct 14: Diuresis started'; HD shows 'Oct 14: Diuresis continuing' then 'Oct 15: Breathing easier on 2 L', and the Oct 10 / Oct 12 lines are hidden. All six window checks held, so no finding: the window is yesterday-and-today (U3), not 'the last N lines'. Q6: the undated line 'Admitted with CHF exacerbation' is shown above them (recorded).
